With my anxiety, I'd avoid; prefer practical computer science over AI math gimmicks."},"reasoning_summary":"Responses embody a conscientious yet highly neurotic, introverted 40-year-old Hindu immigrant man in Milan with low education/openness: admits math limitations, expresses anxiety, gives basic/imperfect explanations, favors practical hobbies over abstract math/AI, uses simple language reflecting background."}
